scenes.text: Moon is a coding agent for Visual Studio Code. It edits code inline, works across a whole project, and changes nothing until you approve.

The Moon panel sits on a thin Visual Studio Code layer; the logic lives in Moon core. Core sends each turn to TrueForge, which runs the agent loop and streams events back. Only TrueForge calls a model: Claude first, DeepSeek as backup. The agent edits a hidden copy through seventeen MCP tools, and only accepted hunks reach your files.

Flask is seventeen thousand lines, so Moon starts small: project rules up to two thousand tokens, and a project map, where files link by the names they use, ranked with PageRank into ten percent of the window. A scout picks the files, report context fills the context card, and the agent reads more until TrueForge compacts.
